mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_LOGIN_DEVICE (DEVICE_ID, MEMBER_ID, TOKEN_HASH, CREATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT) VALUES (SEQ_LOGIN_DEVICE.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{hash}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE + #{days})
mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM TBL_LOGIN_DEVICE d JOIN TBL_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = d.MEMBER_ID WHERE d.TOKEN_HASH = #{hash} AND d.EXPIRES_AT > SYSDATE AND m.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
